text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While visiting the New Year sales, I 
spotted Tokai Teio looking frantically 
around the crowded area.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Huh-wha?! She's really not here! 
...Wh-What should I do...?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What is the matter, Teio? You do not seem 
to wear a tranquil countenance for the 
start of a new year.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Prez! W-We've got a huge problem~~!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You lost sight of Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi in 
this crowd, you say? However... she is a 
sensible girl. Are you not worrying 
excessively?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Because! Even during the New Year shrine 
visit this morning, Tsuru-chan—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: U-Urgh... everything's spinning...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, that's what you get for bowing with 
full power over and over during prayers! 
Come on, let's sit down and rest!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hearing of her conduct... I see. Indeed, 
one cannot help but be concerned.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
How were Tsuyoshi's words and actions? The 
answer might lie there.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Her words and actions, huh~ She was super 
hyped up, looking like she was ready to 
sprint off at any second, I guess...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. "Ready to sprint off at any 
second"... If so—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—...Ah!! I think I just got a flash of 
inspiration too!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
These shoes... No, they're pricey, but 
these ones look just like the 
President's...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Found ya~~!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Teio-chan! Hey, hey! What do you think 
of those shoes over there?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
They're a liiittle expensive, but they 
look just like the ones the President 
uses—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It is only natural that they look alike. 
They are the exact same model. The comfort 
is superb—a masterpiece of artisan 
craftsmanship.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
......Huh?! I'm seeing an apparition of 
the President! I-I-Is this my first dream 
of the New Year~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry! I had no idea we got 
separated! I thought you were right behind 
me the whole time...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You'd better reflect on this properly! And 
also, hold hands when we're in crowded 
places!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Tsuyoshi deeply repents!! Hand-holding, 
let's do it!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh? But if we got separated back 
at the entrance, how did you know I'd be 
here?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A simple deduction. If your urge to run 
was directed toward the mall's shops, this 
was the only logical place. How did you 
know, Teio?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Because... it's right after New Year's 
shrine visit!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right! Finished praying! Hey, 
Tsu-chan, what did you wish for?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Come on~! Even without saying it, 
Teio-chan, you already know, right?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh, kindred spirits. When two hearts 
carry the same passion, it is only natural 
that their paths converge.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...*sniff*! That's so touching...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! What is it, what's wrong?! Did your 
legs go numb this time?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Nope! My heart went numb...! It feels 
like... a bond forged by dreams!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
! ...Aha! Just so you know, even if we 
stand on the same stage, I won't hold 
back, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Of course! That's exactly what I want!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Witnessing such a heartwarming friendship 
right at the start of the new year, I 
renewed my own resolve to work hard.
